newsitem.title: UK: Guinness has control at Nigerian associate.
newsitem.headline: Guinness has control at Nigerian associate.

text.p: Guinness Plc said on Tuesday its brewing arm Guinness Brewing Worldwide would take majority control of its Nigerian associate Guinness Nigeria Plc from January 1 1997.
Under the deal, which involves no cash outlay, Guinness Brewing will convert existing loan stock into equity, increasing its 40 percent holding to 52 percent.
Guinness Nigeria's market capitalisation is currently 25 million stg.
Managing director of Guinness Africa David Hampshire said the move would allow the group to develop the business, which had reached a size where it was advantageous to increase the shareholding.
